limits: Complete route x viewport x language x theme cross-product and below-fold content on every service page; current route inspection scope is listed explicitly.

Complete computed hover/pressed/focus/disabled/loading matrix for every control in both themes. Normal, focus, disabled and calculator error states were visually exercised; not all states were measured.

Contact validation, loading, submission error/retry and success in a isolated UI fixture without enabling production intake. Actual production QA server stayed INTAKE_MODE=disabled, so its form cannot submit. No browser success was simulated or claimed.

Full text-spacing override on every descendant and all routes. This run used root font-size:200%, letter-spacing:.12em and word-spacing:.16em on the calculator; descendant overrides were not globally forced.
Physical devices, Safari/Firefox/Edge, screen reader and other assistive technology were not used.
Whole-logo favicon remains tiny-scale limited; new compact variant is not approved.
Final user review of palette/dark adaptation and public launch remain separate. No merge, public deployment, database, production intake or outbound notifications.
